decision_reason: Published InstaPrism method reproduced from pinned public inputs; 401 samples and 150 Stage 1 pairs pass QC. No qualifying public pathology tumour-content measurement is linkable in inspected sources; transcriptomic composition is the available measurement. Negative ComBat input values were retained exactly as in the published code; no undocumented clipping was applied. No substantial residual construct was identified in reviewed code and abstract. Publisher full text/supplements could not be retrieved; pathology availability and novelty conclusions remain limited to inspected sources. No pCR analysis performed.
